LanguageData.RK_Storyteller_RottyMilden.label: Rotty Milden
LanguageData.RK_Storyteller_RottyMilden.description:
Rotty Milden is a storyteller who weaves tales as laid-back as the countryside itself. She watches you grow your village, meet unfamiliar faces, and watch the settlement grow livelier as traders and travelers pass through.
Her mischievous antics keep the story from getting boring, though now and then they may unexpectedly stir up big trouble.
Major threats are less frequent, while visits, trade, encounters on the road, and new companions joining happen more often.
